title: Design System: Apex Agent Control Plane

motion.name: node-arrive
motion.purpose: Brings topology nodes into the map in causal order.

components.name: Connect Button
components.css: .ds-connect { background:#263ac2; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; font:800 12px Manrope,sans-serif; padding:13px 16px; } .ds-connect:hover { background:#182aa8; } .ds-connect:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #7584df; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Apex presents scope, durable flow, and evidence storage as a readable topology before it presents a queue of records.
keyCharacteristics: Light workspace and compact utility sidebar.

rules.name: Map-Only Grid Rule
rules.body: Fine grid lines are permitted only inside an actual topology or measurement canvas.

dos: Do make scope, event path, and evidence destination readable together.
donts: Don't lead with metric cards, decorative gradients, or an arbitrary dark dashboard shell.
